run_summary: The JMA has issued warnings for heavy rain and landslides in the Amami region (Kagoshima) and Okinawa Main Island. Several volcanoes (Kirishima/Shinmon-dake, Aso, Sakurajima, Suwanosejima, Kuchinoerabu-jima, Meakan-dake) remain at Alert Level 2 or 3 with ongoing ashfall forecasts. No major transport disruptions were reported in the provided feeds, but travelers in these regions should monitor local weather and volcanic activity.
